why.VERIFY: Inquiries, deals and settlement open after identity verification.
why.PROFILE: We show listings that match the fields you care about first.
why.LIKE: Saved listings are easy to find again.
why.ASK: Ask through the in-platform chat so the record stays and you stay protected.
why.POST: Post what you offer or what you need to get introductions.
why.DEAL: When terms match, start a deal and check the contract and fee on the platform.
why.NOTIFY: Get only the notices you need, or get them bundled once a day.
why.SHARE: When someone joins with your code and verifies their identity, you can get the announced reward.

digest.title: Daily summary
digest.on: On. We bundle your notifications and send them once at 8 am.
digest.off: Off. We send each notification as it comes.
digest.note: Notices you must see, such as money or contract notices, still go out right away. Each notification stays in your list.
digest.mailWait: Email is not ready yet, so the summary goes to your site notifications only.

fill.title: Listing helper
fill.sub: For each of your listings, we show the fields worth filling in. Detailed listings get more inquiries.
fill.notRank: The completeness score is only a guide to what to fix. It is not used for display order, search ranking or fees.
fill.off: The listing helper is not in use right now.
fill.empty: You have not posted a listing yet.

tip.TITLE: Write a title of 10 to 60 characters that says what you are offering.
tip.SUMMARY: Add the one-line summary shown in lists.
tip.BODY: Write more than 200 characters about the condition, terms and what is handed over.
tip.PHOTO3: More than three photos make the listing stand out.
tip.FEE: Enter the desired fee and who pays it.
tip.HOURS: Enter the hours when you can be reached.
